changelog.note: 058 K5.3 (decision of 2026-09-28): the legacy 10_AIFLOW_V4/flows/email-actions-bare task proposals (prompt v1.3.0 verbatim, the action dictionary, an evidence gate in code) as a step of the email flow; only a person accepts a proposal.
